extractionLimitations: No domain field was displayed in the template cards or previews.

The production preview used the same generic empty-state copy for Scope, Policy statements, Roles & responsibilities, Exceptions, Review cadence, and Related policies on all 70 records. These placeholders are not saved as authored template content in this dataset.
Purpose was present only when a production description was present; otherwise the preview explicitly stated that the template had no purpose.
Three records had no visible framework badge and no linked controls: HIPAA-004, HIPAA-018, and HIPAA-026.
Two records had no visible category: HIPAA-035 and HIPAA-028.
